title: Create a New Meeting
description: Teams takviminde yeni bir toplantı planlama ve davet oluşturma akışı

steps.action: Click the Calendar icon on the left sidebar
Click the 'New meeting' button at the top right
Type the meeting title in the title field
Add required attendees in the 'Add required attendees' field
Set the start date and time
Set the end date and time
Click the 'Send' button at the top right to create and send invites

expectedResult: Meeting is created, invites are sent, and the event appears in the calendar
